mapper.sql: image_id, post_id, original_name, storage_key, image_url, content_type, file_size, display_order, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_images WHERE post_id=#{postId}
SELECT FROM post_images WHERE image_id=#{imageId} AND post_id=#{postId}
SELECT FROM post_images WHERE post_id=#{postId} ORDER BY display_order, image_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_images (post_id, original_name, storage_key, image_url, content_type, file_size, display_order, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{originalName}, #{storageKey}, #{imageUrl}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{displayOrder}, NOW())
